name: Lord Ello Ebonlocke
summary: Darkshire's mayor, Lord Ello Ebonlocke, works from the Town Hall to keep order amid the growing danger. Stormwind gives little aid, and the town faces horrors from the surrounding woods.

sections.title: A Beleaguered Mayor
sections.body: Lord Ello Ebonlocke governs Darkshire from the town hall as danger closes around the settlement. Darkshire was once part of the prosperous rural haven called Grand Hamlet. Now perpetual shadow hangs over it, while ravenous ghouls, skeletal abominations, and feral beasts press against its borders. Ello leads the Council of Darkshire and struggles to keep the remnants of civic life working. Stormwind offers little help as the town fights to endure.

sections.title: A Divided Frontier
sections.body: Darkshire depends on local volunteer militias like the Night Watch because Stormwind's garrison will not spare soldiers for the borderlands. His relative, Althea Ebonlocke, commands the Night Watch. Magistrate Solomon of Lakeshire asks for reinforcements against Blackrock orcs, but Lord Ebonlocke cannot spare a single blade. He explains to messengers from Redridge that sending guards beyond the forest's edge would leave Darkshire's homes open to the surrounding evils.

sections.title: Blind to the Hermit's Designs
sections.body: Lord Ello Ebonlocke relies on wandering adventurers to handle unusual matters around the woods. In his wish to help Duskwood's residents, he coordinates communications with solitary figures such as the hermit Abercrombie. Ello cannot understand the hermit's cryptic writings, and fails to see the grisly, stitched nightmare growing just beyond town until nearly too late.

faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke governs Darkshire and leads the Council of Darkshire. From the Town Hall, he oversees the town's defense and civic affairs as its human residents struggle to survive.

faq.q: How is he related to Commander Althea Ebonlocke?
faq.answer: Commander Althea Ebonlocke is Lord Ello's relative and leads the Night Watch. He handles Darkshire's civic and diplomatic affairs while she commands the militia guarding the settlement.

faq.q: Why does Lord Ebonlocke refuse to send troops to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Lord Ebonlocke refuses Magistrate Solomon's request for aid against the Blackrock orcs in Redridge. Darkshire faces undead and other horrors, and sending its guards away would leave the town open to being overrun.

faq.q: Where can Lord Ello Ebonlocke be found?
faq.answer: Lord Ello Ebonlocke can be found inside the Darkshire Town Hall, at the center of Darkshire in eastern Duskwood.

faq.q: Why doesn't Stormwind send troops to help Lord Ebonlocke?
faq.answer: Stormwind's resources are strained by internal political strife after King Varian Wrynn's disappearance. The House of Nobles has largely abandoned the southern regions, leaving local leaders like Lord Ebonlocke to organize their own defenses.

faq.q: What is Lord Ebonlocke's involvement with Abercrombie?
faq.answer: Lord Ebonlocke helps handle communications with the hermit Abercrombie and arranges translations of his strange notes.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you see how isolated mayors on its forgotten edges lead their people through nightmare conditions with little aid from Stormwind.
As a human traveling from Stormwind, you find in Lord Ebonlocke a sobering reminder of how far the southern provinces have fallen into ruin and abandonment.
